title: Predicator conformance analysis case
description: One completed, shipped case as it appears in conformance/analysis/corpus.json - one JSON object per line, produced by mix corpus.generate from an authored analysis case (schema/analysis_case.json). See conformance/README.md, "The analysis surface".

id.description: Human-chosen, path-like, unique, stable forever, always under analysis/.

source.description: The program, or null for a case authored as instructions. A runner reading the source compares positions as written.

instructions.description: The instruction list, tagged-value encoded: what the source compiles to as a program, or the authored list. A runner reading the instructions compares every position as null.

references.description: Every variable read, in source order.

position.description: [line, column], 1-based, where the path starts; null when read from instructions.

calls.description: Every function call, in source order, an outer call before the calls in its arguments.

name.description: The name as written, dots included.

position.description: [line, column], 1-based, of the call; null when read from instructions.

assignments.description: Every location the program stores to, in source order.

position.description: [line, column], 1-based, where the location starts; null when read from instructions.

notes.description: Free text, carried over from the authored case unchanged.
